resource: USE_INTENT payload under RUNE_USE_V1 (the UseWithV1 position arm included)
allocation_impact: Capability 22 does not raise the USE_INTENT bound: the position arm is at most 16 bytes (SPELL-D7 sint32 x and y, an int16 floor), the largest intent with it and field 2 or 5 is 33 bytes, far below the existing 529-byte payload limit, and the decoder refuses any larger payload before parsing.
boundary_tests: max=529: a 529-byte USE_INTENT is accepted with capability 22 selected
max+1=530: a 530-byte USE_INTENT is refused with capability 22 selected
notes: Registered by RUNE-WIRE-1 (RUNE-USE-0 §4, #1622). Mirrors max_payload_bytes of command type 2.
